## Description
Brief description of what this Pull Request (PR) does.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New algorithm (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test improvement

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows the style guide (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Self-review completed
- [ ] Comments added for complex logic
- [ ] Docstring includes at least one example
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] All tests pass locally (`python tests/run_tests.py`)
- [ ] No external dependencies added
- [ ] Commit message is clear and descriptive

## Related issues
Fixes # (issue number)
